description:
Program Overview

The High Performance Humanoid Technologies Lab (H2T) at Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT) is offering a doctoral researcher position in human-robot interaction and dexterous manipulation. The lab focuses on developing advanced humanoid robots with sophisticated manipulation capabilities for industrial and service applications.

Funding & Benefits

  • Salary: TV-L E13 (100%) - approximately €50,000 - €55,000 per year for 3-4 years
  • Research Budget: €5,000+ per year for conference travel and equipment
  • Social Benefits: German social security (health insurance, pension, etc.)
  • Vacation: 30 days per year (German standard)
  • Training: Access to German language courses and professional development

Research Focus

  • Humanoid Robotics: Developing advanced humanoid robots with human-like capabilities
  • Dexterous Manipulation: Creating robotic hands with human-level dexterity
  • Human-Robot Interaction: Designing intuitive interfaces
  • Tactile Sensing: Developing artificial skin for robotic perception
  • Learning from Demonstration: Programming robots through human demonstration

Eligibility Criteria

  • Academic Background: Master's degree (or equivalent) in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
  • Research Experience: Prior experience in robotics, control systems, or human-machine interaction
  • Language Proficiency: English proficiency (German is beneficial but not required)
  • Technical Skills: Programming experience (C++, Python, ROS)

Application Process

  1. Submit application with CV and research statement.
  2. Review by H2T Lab.
  3. Interview with lab director and team members.
  4. Technical assessment if required.
  5. Job offer and contract.
  6. Begin doctoral research.

Required Documents

  • CV/Resume highlighting academic and research experience
  • Research Statement (2-3 pages)
  • Transcripts (all academic records)
  • Letters of Recommendation (2-3 letters)
  • Publications (if any)

Timeline & Deadlines

StageDate
Application OpensImmediate
Application DeadlineOpen until filled
Interview ProcessRolling basis
Start DateFlexible

Official Link

https://www.kit.edu

Important Notes

  • KIT is one of Europe's leading technical universities for engineering.
  • Work with state-of-the-art humanoid robots like ARMAR-6.
  • Strong partnerships with German industry for technology transfer.
  • Technical requirements: C++, Python, ROS, robot kinematics and dynamics, control theory, motion planning.
